name: Weapon Familiarity
text: **Weapon Familiarity**: Half-elves raised among elves often feel pitied and mistrusted by their longer-lived kin, and yet they receive training in elf weapons. They gain the elf ’s weapon familiarity trait. This racial trait replaces adaptability.
